verdict.rationale: Docs show a <10‑minute voice-assistant quickstart (prompt+voice) plus a dedicated telephony/SIP stack for inbound/outbound calls (trunks, phone number), and runtime probes confirm the framework and self-hosted server actually install and boot without extra keys. Together these cover prompt, voice, and phone number needed for a first live call within an hour. Missing for 10: a single unified, hands-on-verified tutorial that walks through phone-number provisioning and first live call end-to-end (currently voice-quickstart and telephony docs are separate), and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of the 'within an hour' timeline.
